summary: A North Sydney property and planning boutique with recognised specialists is a strength, but copied award labels and clashing contact details appear to cost you enquiries.

findings.problem: Two phone numbers appear (02 8318 0788 and 02 9929 7071), the address appears in two formats, and the hours line appears to link to a map.
findings.cost: A client cannot tell which number to call, and mixed details look careless for a law firm.
findings.fix: One verified phone, address and hours block.

findings.problem: The enquiry dropdown appears to show literal asterisks ('*Select Legal Service*') and the form labels appear with stray characters such as 'Full Name \*'.
findings.cost: Visible form glitches make a client doubt that the message will arrive.
findings.fix: A clean labeled form with a clear submit button.

findings.problem: Image text appears to name another organisation ('Doyles 2026 Environment icon'), and the testimonial text appears to contain 'plesant people' and '87 years lifetime'.
findings.cost: Copied labels and typos weaken the proof you want a new client to trust.
findings.fix: Correct award labels and proofread testimonials.

findings.problem: The claims '95% success rate' and 'thousands of clients' appear with no basis, two case studies appear in both News and Case Studies, and the Team section appears to show only 3 of 9 people.
findings.cost: Unexplained numbers and repeated content make proof look thin.
findings.fix: Sourced results, distinct case studies and a full team page.

redesign: Correct awards, sourced results and a full team page.
